entities.name: Luis de Requesens y de Zúñiga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis de Requesens y Zúñiga was a Spanish general, sailor, diplomat and politician. He served as governor of the Duchy of Milan (1572–1573) and as governor of the Spanish Netherlands (1573–1576).
